youtube_description: Video with Helen Zille, who is Premier of the Western Cape, South Africa. Video was shot in the WaterCube at the UN World Water Day conference in Cape Town, South Africa. Helen explains why water and urbanization is of such importance in Cape Town and South Africa as a whole. by Luuk Diphoorn on 20 March 2011. (Mar 20, 2011)
